name: gente-preta-monorepo
description: Gente Preta — Site Institucional + App Sentinela. Deploy Opção A: um único domínio Cloudflare, App publicado em /app/.

scripts.install:all: npm run install:site && npm run install:app
scripts.assemble: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r site/dist/. dist/ && mkdir -p dist/app && cp -r app/dist/. dist/app/ && cp worker/index.js dist/_worker.js
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:site && npm run build:app && npm run assemble
